item.title: Open PDF Editor 0.5.0
item.description: Editing. Edit › Edit Content (⌥⌘E) lets you change what's on the page: click text with the Text tool and double-click to retype it, or change its font, size and colour in the inspector (when a character isn't in the PDF's own font, a matching Mac font is embedded with just the letters used); add, move, resize, replace and delete images; and draw links to web pages, email addresses or other pages. Pages › Add Headers & Footers, Add Page Numbers and Add Watermark stamp text on all or some pages, and can be removed again. Change the document's title, author, subject and keywords in the inspector. When no document is open, a new welcome window offers New PDF or Open…, and File › New makes a blank PDF. Every change can be undone.
